justification.T_YUV_codes: swscale fixed point vs exact rounding: one code per plane
justification.T_RGB_raw_interior: floor (2) + one residual level from <=1-code plane drift; also the level the author reported (<=3)
justification.T_RGB_mp4_interior: T_RGB_raw_interior + 1 for x264 and the decoder's own conversion
justification.T_symptom_min_error_baseline: the reported symptom was 44,78,102 vs 48,80,106 (largest channel 4)

posthoc_bias_description.label: POST-HOC, not pre-registered: exploratory description of the E01/E12 bias

two_stage_oracle.description: E12 codes (what the colour source drew, BT.601) -> exact rational RGB (no rounding/clipping) -> exact BT.709 limited rounding. This is the best any 8-bit-source yuv->yuv re-matrixing could give; compare with what scale produced (E01).

oracle_floor.description: exact BT.709 limited 4:2:0 of the chart (patch edges align with chroma blocks) decoded with nearest chroma: the best an 8-bit 4:2:0 chart can do with this decoder
